goal_fade_text: The number shows how many tiles it stays lit. If it goes out before the door, you can't win.
goal_bridge_text: Turns 90° after each tile (the faded one shows what's next). Cross only along it.
tip_stash: You can stash a tile here
tip_turn: Arrows turn along with the road
tip_lantern: Light all lanterns to open the door
tip_side_entry: You can enter the arch from the side
tip_drag: You can drag a tile to the road
tip_turnbridge: The bridge turns after the next tile
tip_fade: The lantern went out before the door
intro_line2: Light a path to the arch
rule_road_text: Tap a tile and the road grows. Lead it to the door.
rule_lantern_text: The road must pass through every lantern. Until they're lit, the door stays locked.
rule_side_text: You can enter the door from the left, right, top or bottom.
rule_rock_text: The road can't pass through rocks — go around them.
rule_water_text: You can cross the river only by bridge.
rule_firefly_text: Collect fireflies if you like. The road picks up every firefly it passes.
rule_jump_text: A jump hops over one cell: a rock, water or a lantern (the lantern doesn't light up).
rule_turnbridge_text: After each tile the bridge turns 90°; the faded one shows what's next. You can only cross along the bridge.
rule_fade_text: The number shows how many tiles the lantern stays lit. If it goes out before the door, you can't win.
rule_ffgoal_text: There's no door here: collect all the fireflies to win.
currency_coin: Coins come from levels and stars. Spend them on outfits and upgrades.
currency_light: Light comes from stars and fireflies. It lights up the village.
currency_note: From now on, just icons: {coin} and {light}
village_bonuses_empty: Restore buildings — each gives its own bonus forever.
village_chest_text: Tomorrow there'll be a new chest on the square.
hint_daily: Plus the daily reward on the map — come back every day.
building.well.name: Well
building.well.story: Without light, the well dried up long ago.
building.well.lit: The water is clean and cold again.
building.bakery.name: Baker's House
building.bakery.story: The oven went cold, and the valley no longer smells of bread.
building.bakery.lit: The whole valley smells of fresh bread.
building.workshop.name: Workshop
building.workshop.story: The tools are rusting in the dark.
building.mill.name: Mill
building.mill.story: The mill's sails stand still without wind and light.
building.mill.lit: The sails turn, and the millstones grind grain.
building.bridge.name: Bridge
building.bridge.story: The planks have gone dark, and people fear to cross.
building.garden.name: Garden
building.garden.story: The flowers have closed, waiting for light.
building.garden.lit: The garden blooms, with fireflies circling above.
building.chapel.name: Chapel
building.chapel.story: The bell has been silent for many evenings.
building.chapel.lit: The bell rings, calling everyone to supper.
building.square.name: Lantern Square
building.square.story: The square's lanterns went out one by one.
building.square.lit: The square shines, and the whole village gathers here.
building.lumo.name: Lumo's House
building.lumo.story: Your home is waiting for you to return with a light.
building.lumo.lit: It's warm and cozy at home.
building.lighthouse.name: Lighthouse
building.lighthouse.story: The lighthouse went dark, and travelers lose their way.
building.lighthouse.lit: The lighthouse beam guides travelers home again.

building.herbalist.name: Herbalist's Cottage
building.herbalist.story: The dried herbs are scattered, and the cauldron went cold long ago.
building.herbalist.lit: It smells of mint and chamomile — the herbalist is brewing tea again.
building.observatory.name: Observatory
building.observatory.story: The dome has rusted, and the telescope stares at the ground.
building.observatory.lit: The stargazer counts the stars again until morning.
building.owl-post.name: Owl Post
building.owl-post.story: The owls flew away, and the letters are soaking in the rain.
building.owl-post.lit: The owls are back — letters fly through the forest again.
building.mushroom-farm.name: Mushroom Farm
building.mushroom-farm.story: The beds are overgrown, and the mushrooms have faded.
building.mushroom-farm.lit: The mushrooms glow turquoise — it's harvest time on the farm.
building.sawmill.name: Sawmill
building.sawmill.story: The wheel has stopped, and the saw has rusted.
building.sawmill.lit: The wheel is humming, and it smells of fresh wood shavings.
building.lamp-workshop.name: Lantern Workshop
building.lamp-workshop.story: Unlit lanterns hang in the dust.
building.lamp-workshop.lit: Hundreds of lanterns wait to light someone's way.
building.teahouse.name: Teahouse
building.teahouse.story: The paper lanterns are torn, and the tables are empty.
building.teahouse.lit: Friends drink tea and tell stories at the tables again.
building.forester.name: Forester's House
building.forester.story: The door creaks, and the stove is cold.
building.forester.lit: The forester lights the stove and knows every path.
building.swing-bridge.name: Swing Bridge
building.swing-bridge.story: The ropes sag, and the planks fell into the stream.
building.swing-bridge.lit: The bridge sways, but it holds — on we go!
building.glow-lake.name: Glowing Lake
building.glow-lake.story: The water has darkened, and the little lights fell asleep.
building.glow-lake.lit: The lake shines turquoise, with fireflies circling above.

consent_note: You can change this at any time in your profile.
map_forest_locked: Complete the Valley challenge to enter the forest
forest_intro_text: The mist hides the path. Light it up again!
goal_escape: Escape the shadow through the arch
goal_ring_text: A road entering a ring comes out of the ring of the same colour, going the same way.
goal_fog_text: You only see cells next to the road and lit lanterns. The arch, lanterns and rings glow through the fog.
goal_observatory: Observatory: you see {n, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}} further
goal_shadow_text: Appears at the start after {n, plural, one {# move} other {# moves}} and runs along the road after Lumo, 2 cells per move. A lit lantern holds it back for a move.
goal_herbalist: The herbalist holds the shadow back {n, plural, one {once} other {# times}}
lose_shadow: The shadow caught Lumo. A shorter road, “straight ×2”, rings and lanterns help you get away.
rule_ring_text: Step into a ring and come out of the ring of the same colour, going the same way.
rule_fog_text: The fog clears around the road and lit lanterns. The arch, lanterns and rings are always visible.
rule_shadow_text: The number at the start is how many moves until the shadow comes. It runs along the road faster than Lumo — loops won't save you.
rule_escape_text: The arch is open from the start — reach it before the shadow catches you. A lantern on the way holds it back for a move.
